name: Tao moi Product Base (thu cong)
user_goal: La owner, tao moi mot product base qua form /products/new, voi validation toi thieu, de co ban ghi san sang cau hinh printarea/variant/mockup tiep theo.

actors.permission_observed: Truy cap va submit form /products/new khong gap access-denied; THEM MOI trong lần khảo sát nay: tao 10 product test chi dien title, tao product voi title whitespace-only/HTML/XSS payload.

capabilities.name: Form 6 field
capabilities.description: Product title, Internal name (optional), Internal tags (optional), Fulfillment provider, Fulfillment catalog ID, Description - khong field nao mang dau hieu bat buoc trong DOM. Da xac nhan qua evidence: server chi bat buoc Product title, 5 field con lai deu duoc phep bo trong khi tao.

capabilities.name: Product title pre-fill gia tri that
capabilities.description: Input.value = 'Example MUG' (khong phai placeholder); Save khong sua se tao product ten do.

capabilities.name: Tooltip huong dan 3 field
capabilities.description: Fulfillment provider, Fulfillment catalog ID, Description deu co tooltip giai thich hanh vi.

capabilities.name: Chon Fulfillment provider qua multiselect
capabilities.description: Khong co nut X de bo chon ve trang thai blank ('Others') sau khi da chon.

capabilities.name: Submit tao product base
capabilities.description: POST /api/products; server tu set nhieu field mac dinh; mapping field UI -> payload ro rang. Chi Product title la bat buoc thuc su (10/10 product test chi dien title deu tao thanh cong 201); title toan whitespace bi coi la KHONG co title, chan hoan toan o client, khong gui request.

capabilities.name: Redirect + wizard onboarding sau khi tao
capabilities.description: Redirect sang /products/{id}/edit kem wizard 'Step 1/3 Upload Mockup...'; trang thai wizard ghi qua PUT /api/user/guide-config.

capabilities.name: Khoi 'Advanced options'
capabilities.description: Luon disabled tren form New; dieu kien enable thuc su (bien UI nao kich hoat) van chua xac dinh (xem KB-020, coverage_gap). Ve mat noi dung: du lieu cua Advanced options duoc nap tu du lieu import cua nha in, TeeInBlue khong phu trach yeu cau fulfillment cu the tung nha in - day la quyet dinh san pham cua PO.

state_transitions.condition: Product title khong rong (va khong toan whitespace) -> POST 201
chan hoan toan o CLIENT, khong POST

confirmed_rules.statement: [CHK-02-008, mot phan] Product title chi gom khoang trang (whitespace-only) bi coi nhu KHONG co title: client chan hoan toan, KHONG co request POST /api/products nao duoc gui, san pham khong duoc tao.

[CHK-02-012, business decision] 'Advanced options' duoc nap tu du lieu import cua nha in ve; khi fulfill can mot so thong tin trong Advanced options moi fulfill duoc nhung dieu nay tuy tung san pham va do nha in quy dinh - TeeInBlue KHONG phu trach phan do.

observed_behavior.statement: Khong field nao co dau hieu bat buoc trong DOM (khong *, khong aria-required) tru khi thu submit thuc te.
Field UI -> payload: 'Internal name' -> label; 'Internal tags' -> internal_tags; 'Fulfillment catalog ID' -> fulfillment_linked_id; Description luu dang HTML.

Server set nhieu field mac dinh khi tao (status=0, had_back=false, enable_custom_printarea=false, color_display_type='radio', size_display_type='radio'); khi khong gui Internal name, server set label = title.
Sau khi tao, redirect + wizard onboarding 3 buoc, trang thai wizard ghi qua PUT /api/user/guide-config.

Nut Advanced options disabled tren /products/new va tren product base tao tay; chi enabled tren product base imported co catalog ID - bien quyet dinh chua xac dinh (fulfillment_id, is_imported, catalog ID, hay dang duoc campaign dung). VAN LA coverage_gap chua duoc lam ro trong lần khảo sát nay.

[CHK-02-009] Tao 10 product base test chi dien Product title, de trong moi field khac: 10/10 deu tra 201 - xac nhan server KHONG bat buoc field nao khac ngoai title o buoc tao Product Base. Voi Printarea: de trong Display name van tao thanh cong (dung default). Voi Variant: de trong Weight/Compare price van tao thanh cong khi du SKU/Color/Size/Price; import thieu SKU tra loi ro rang 'SKU is required in row 2'. PO chi de nghi 'thu lần khảo sát case' (khong assert ket qua cu the) nen giu OBSERVED_CURRENT du evidence manh (10 mau).

[CHK-02-008, phan SEC-002, MEDIUM-HIGH] Title/label chap nhan HTML tho, escape KHONG nhat quan giua 2 vi tri hien thi CUNG 1 field tren list: dong link tieu de escape dung, dong label ben duoi (tu sinh tu title) KHONG escape (chu in dam that, the duoc chen that vao DOM). Payload chua '

observed_validations.input: Product title rong, bam Save (lap 4 lan, ket qua on dinh)
Product title chi gom khoang trang (' '), bam Save
observed_validations.message_verbatim: (khong co request nao gui di, chan hoan toan o client)

permissions.statement: Chi quan sat duoc 1 role (owner); chua biet role khac co bi gioi han field/bi chan tao product base hay khong.

api.item: POST /api/products (tao product base; chi title bat buoc; whitespace-only chan client; HTML/XSS chua sanitize server-side quan sat duoc)

dependencies.relation: sau khi tao, wizard dan sang buoc them printarea/mockup; tap field bat buoc rieng cua printarea (Display name khong bat buoc)
tap field bat buoc rieng cua variant (SKU bat buoc khi import, Weight/Compare price khong bat buoc)

risks.risk: Response 422 khi title rong khong co inline field error/highlight, chi co toast - de bi bo sot khi kiem tra UI/accessibility.
Multiselect Fulfillment provider khong co cach bo chon ve 'Others' tu form New - gay kho khan neu chon nham provider truoc khi Save.

Bien quyet dinh enable 'Advanced options' chua ro - rui ro viet test case sai gia dinh ve dieu kien hien thi Required options. Van la coverage_gap chua duoc lam ro trong lần khảo sát nay (KB-070 chi giai thich noi dung/muc dich cua Advanced options, khong giai thich bien UI nao kich hoat no).

[SEC-002, MEDIUM-HIGH, can chuyen security reviewer] Title/label chap nhan HTML tho khong sanitize server-side quan sat duoc; escape khong nhat quan giua 2 vi tri hien thi cung field tren list (dong label khong escape, co the chen HTML/anh that vao DOM). Chua xac dinh day co khai thac duoc thanh XSS thuc su hay khong (onerror khong thuc thi trong sample nay).

unknown_areas.question: HTML/XSS payload (KB-068) co thuc su khai thac duoc thanh XSS (vd script chay qua vector khac ngoai onerror) hay khong?
unknown_areas.why_it_matters: SEC-002 moi o muc quan sat 1 lan (observed_count=3, cung 1 phien); can security reviewer danh gia muc do nghiem trong that su truoc khi xep loai bug uu tien cao hay chap nhan duoc.
